content.text:
The member at the front of the hold queue can now check the item out, and members queued behind them no longer stop that checkout. All 61 tests pass, which is the 60 existing ones plus one new one. I haven't committed anything.

**Cause:** `findBlockingHold` in `lib/holds/queue.js` returned any active hold belonging to a different member. If Ada was first in the queue and Ben was second, Ben's hold blocked Ada's checkout.

**Fix:** It now looks only at the front of the queue, using the existing `holdQueue` ordering (earliest placed first). If the front hold is the borrower's own, nothing blocks them. Otherwise the front hold blocks them. So a member queued behind someone, or not queued at all, is still told the item is held for someone else.

**Test:** I added a case to `test/checkout.test.js` with Ada first and Ben second. Ben is refused with `on-hold`, and Ada can borrow.
